headline: Continues to gain market share in water purifiers

highlights: We note: (1) It has stepped up investments in ad-spends to strengthen its competitive positioning and accelerate growth across key categories.
Despite these investments, EBITDA margin expanded 29bps YoY to 12.9%, marking its highest-ever quarterly margin.
(2) Water purifier growth remains volume-led, supported by market share gains, while robotic vacuum cleaners, water softeners and air purifiers continued to scale up.
(3) Despite higher competitive intensity in water purifiers, management remains confident of its ability to sustain market share gains, supported by a comprehensive product portfolio.
valuation: Maintain BUY with a DCF-based revised TP of INR 444 (earlier 600) implied P/E at 31x FY28E EPS.
Maintain BUY with a DCF-based revised TP of INR 444 (earlier 600) (implied target P/E at 31x FY28E EPS).

The full impact of the price increase is expected to be visible in Q4FY27. • Management expects margins to recover in Q4FY27 and target broadly flat adjusted EBITDA margins for FY27. • A&SP investments increased during H1FY27.
